title: Check Commons Text PR 586 CSV return preservation
description: On the original Commons Text PR revisions compiled with their own Commons Lang 3.16.0 and 3.17.0 dependencies, run the public strict native equivalence workflow on StringEscapeUtils.escapeCsv for all non-null fields of length zero through three over a, comma, double quote, CR and LF. Record the first unsupported step or a qualified result. The independent JVM oracle and calibration-only quote-doubling mutant have separate replay tasks.
expected: example 349 task preservation gives its expected conclusion, established: build.py prints 'as expected' and exits 0

resources.notes: Two 15-file source checkouts, compilation, deterministic 156-field JVM controls and a bounded native comparison.
